# Zig libc.txt for cross-compiling to x86_64-windows-gnu
# Generated by ginwasaas build setup.
#
# Contains system MinGW headers/libs merged with vendored sqlite3.
# The merged directories are symlink farms where each entry points
# to the real file under /usr/x86_64-w64-mingw32/* or
# vendor/sqlite3/{amalgamation,windows-amd64}/*.
#
# Usage:
#   zig build --libc vendor/sqlite3/libc-windows-amd64.txt \
#             -Dtarget=x86_64-windows-gnu

# The directory that contains `stdlib.h`.
include_dir=/home/ginwa/ginwasaas/vendor/sqlite3/libc-windows-amd64/include

# The system-specific include directory. May be the same as `include_dir`.
# On Windows it's the directory that includes `vcruntime.h`.
sys_include_dir=/home/ginwa/ginwasaas/vendor/sqlite3/libc-windows-amd64/include

# The directory that contains `crt1.o` or `crt2.o`.
crt_dir=/home/ginwa/ginwasaas/vendor/sqlite3/libc-windows-amd64/lib

# MinGW uses GNU-ABI, not MSVC; leave these empty.
msvc_lib_dir=
kernel32_lib_dir=

# Not targeting Haiku.
gcc_dir=
